   *Expected benefit:* A 1 °C rise in set‑point can cut HVAC energy by roughly 5 %–10 % for that floor, saving about 0.18–0.36 kWh per hour during peak.

   *What to do:* Set the ventilation system to increase airflow only when CO₂ rises above 800 ppm (a common comfort threshold).

   *Why:* Occupancy status is measured; lights running when rooms are empty waste energy.  
   *What to do:* Program lights to dim or shut off automatically when the occupancy sensor reports “unoccupied.”  
   *Expected benefit:* Typical buildings see 10 %–20 % lighting savings with this rule, translating to several kWh per month.
